tools.name: create_quick_form
tools.description: Create a form without a Wrenform account, using only the email address that should receive submissions. Wrenform emails that address once to confirm. Until it's confirmed, submissions are held and nothing is forwarded. Unconfirmed forms expire after 7 days. Tell the user to check their inbox and cli

tools.name: check_quick_form
tools.description: Check whether a quick form has been confirmed: pending_confirmation, active, expired or declined. No submission data is available here; to manage the form, the user signs in at https://wrenform.com/app.

tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Get ready-to-paste code for a form in a given framework: html (no JavaScript), html_strict_csp, fetch, nextjs, astro, react, vue, nuxt, svelte, hugo, jekyll, framer, webflow. Insert it into the site as returned; it already includes the spam honeypot.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Get a Wrenform docs page as Markdown (e.g. 'quick-start', 'spam', 'redirects', 'fields', 'webhooks', 'errors', 'frameworks/nextjs').

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "quick" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_quick_form, get_snippet · Public sink: create_quick_form.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_quick_form, get_snippet · Public sink: create_quick_form

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
